facts.content: Patient reports decreased hearing in the left ear for a duration of 6 weeks.
Patient experiences intermittent decreased hearing, associated with left-sided tinnitus and mild off-balance dizziness.
facts.source_text: Intermittent; assoc L tinnitus, mild off-balance dizziness

facts.content: TV and music can trigger ringing in the ears.
No ear pain, ear discharge, fever, chest pain, or palpitations reported.

facts.content: Patient reports the right ear is normal.
Patient had a brief similar episode about 1 year ago that resolved on its own.

facts.content: Patient denies using cotton buds for ear cleaning.
Unilateral sensorineural versus conductive hearing loss in the left ear to rule out cerumen impaction.

facts.content: Book a face-to-face GP visit within 4–5 days for otoscopy and evaluation of possible wax or other pathology.
